phrase.en: I appreciate your qualification, and you phrased it better than I did just now.
phrase.zh: 我很欣赏你这个补充说明，而且你刚才表达得比我更贴切。

phrase.en: The phrase a question mark around something means there's doubt or uncertainty about something.
phrase.zh: 短语“对某事打上问号（a question mark around something）”意思是某事存在怀疑或不确定性。

phrase.en: The phrase, one-size-fits-all, describes trying to apply the same solution to many different problems.
phrase.zh: “一刀切”这个短语描述的是试图将相同的解决方案应用于许多不同的问题。

phrase.en: The phrase us versus them is used to show hostility between two opposing groups.
phrase.zh: us versus them 这个短语用来表示两个对立群体之间的敌意。

phrase.en: The phrase separated at birth can be used to describe two people with strong similarities.
phrase.zh: 短语“出生时分离”可以用来描述两个有强烈相似之处的人。

physical.en: The physical presence of the authority figure, it turned out, was an important factor.
physical.zh: 事实证明，权威人物是否亲身在场，是一个重要因素。

physical.en: In a physical classroom, you might chat with your friend before your class starts.
physical.zh: 在一个实体的教室里，你可能会在上课前和朋友聊聊天。

physical.en: Overwhelm can lead to burnout, mental or physical exhaustion caused by working too hard.
physical.zh: 不堪重负会导致精疲力竭，即工作过度导致的心理或身体极度疲劳。

physical.en: Now, there is one more physical consequence of fire we need to talk about.
physical.zh: 现在，我们还需要讨论火带来的另一个生理影响。

physical.en: Burnout is a feeling of physical or mental exhaustion caused by working too hard.
physical.zh: Burnout 是指工作过度导致的身体或心理疲劳感。

phenomenon.en: I try to persist as much as possible. Maybe that’s why this phenomenon is so interesting to me.
phenomenon.zh: 我尽量去坚持。也许这就是这个现象对我来说如此有趣的原因吧。

phenomenon.en: It's a tale about the psychological phenomenon of scarcity.
phenomenon.zh: 这是一个关于稀缺心理现象的故事。

phenomenon.en: Of course this isn’t a uniquely British phenomenon.
phenomenon.zh: 当然，这并非英国独有的现象。

phenomenon.en: But clearly, this is a relatively modern phenomenon.
phenomenon.zh: 但很明显，这相对来说是一个现代现象。

phenomenon.en: It's the same phenomenon. It's that somebody has to get out there and be that pioneer, be that Vasco da Gama.
phenomenon.zh: 这其实是同一种现象。总得有人挺身而出，去当那个开拓者，去当那个瓦斯科·达伽马。

physically.en: What all these routines have in common is that, physically, they are incredibly hard.
physically.zh: 所有这些成套动作的共同点是，在体力上，它们都极其艰难。

physically.en: For example, when someone says “break the ice “, they don’t mean physically breaking ice.
physically.zh: 例如，当有人说“break the ice”时，他们并不是指物理上去破冰。

physically.en: After an hour or two of this, decluttering becomes physically and emotionally exhausting.
physically.zh: 经过一两个小时的这样折腾，断舍离就会变得让人身心俱疲。

physically.en: The bleeding, the purging, the blistering, these would have weakened him physically.
physically.zh: 放血、泻药、起泡剂，这些都会在肉体上削弱他。

physically.en: You are physically present with a teacher and surrounded by other students.
physically.zh: 你与老师同处一室，身边环绕着其他学生。

philosopher.en: This leads us to an ancient question that philosophers have been debating for over 2000 years.
philosopher.zh: 这引导我们走向一个哲学家们已经争论了2000多年的古老问题。

philosopher.en: The ship became a standing example among the philosophers for the logical question of things that grow.
philosopher.zh: 这艘船成了哲学家们关于事物生长逻辑问题的一个常备例子。

philosopher.en: One person watching closely was a German-American political philosopher named Hannah Arendt.
philosopher.zh: 当时密切关注这场审判的人中，有一位名叫汉娜·阿伦特(Hannah Arendt)的德裔美国政治哲学家。

philosopher.en: It has been debated by philosophers who like to discuss whether the past and future actually exist.
philosopher.zh: 哲学家们也一直在争论过去和未来是否真的存在。

philosopher.en: He was a libertarian and a strong admirer of the Austrian philosopher and economist Ludwig von Mises.
philosopher.zh: 他是一个自由意志主义者，也是奥地利哲学家和经济学家 Ludwig von Mises 的狂热崇拜者。

physics.en: Every scientific field, from physics to chemistry to computer science, depends on mathematical thinking.
physics.zh: 每一个科学领域，从物理学、化学到计算机科学，都依赖于数学思维。

physics.en: This concept opened the door to entirely new fields of physics and chemistry.
physics.zh: 这一概念为物理学和化学开辟了全新的领域。

physics.en: Her father taught maths and physics and made sure to educate his children in the sciences.
physics.zh: 她的父亲是一名数学和物理老师，并确保让孩子们接受科学教育。

physics.en: And I've actually underwritten media and some physics stuff.
physics.zh: 我实际上已经资助了媒体和一些物理学项目。

physics.en: Isaac Newton revolutionized physics, mathematics, and astronomy.
physics.zh: Isaac Newton彻底革新了物理学、数学和天文学。

physician.en: This was alongside works of Aristotle, the great Greek physician Galen, and more.
physician.zh: 这与亚里士多德、伟大的希腊医师盖伦等人的著作一起出现。

physician.en: George's regular physicians have no idea what to do.
physician.zh: George 的御医们束手无策。

physician.en: And while the physicians might well have believed they were doing the right thing, indeed the only thing they could, they were almost certainly making it worse.
physician.zh: 虽然医生们可能深信他们做的是对的事，甚至是他们唯一能做的事，但他们几乎肯定把病情弄得更糟了。

physician.en: Through contact with the Islamic world, in Spain, Sicily, and during the Crusades, European scholars rediscovered long-lost works of ancient philosophers, physicians, and thinkers.
physician.zh: 通过与西班牙、西西里以及在十字军东征期间与伊斯兰世界的接触，欧洲学者重新发现了古希腊哲学家、医师和思想家长期失传的著作。

photography.en: Thirty seconds later, it is over. One man has disappeared into a nearby photography studio.
photography.zh: 三十秒后，一切结束了。一名男子已经躲进了附近的照相馆。

photography.en: In a narrow vacant lot beside a photography studio in Tombstone, Arizona, eight men are standing close together.
photography.zh: 在亚利桑那州汤姆斯通(Tombstone)一家照相馆旁边的一块狭窄空地上，八名男子紧紧站在一起。

phase.en: The next phase in Will's life began the way so many new beginnings do these days, with the dating app OKCupid.
phase.zh: Will人生的下一阶段像如今许多新的开始一样，从约会软件OKCupid开始了。

phase.en: That is the exploration phase. Later, when you found the thing you want to work on, you're in the exploitation phase.
phase.zh: 那是探索阶段。后来，当你找到了你想做的事情时，你就进入了开发阶段。

phase.en: That is the exploration phase. Later, when you found the thing you want to work on, you're in the exploitation phase.
phase.zh: 那是探索阶段。后来，当你找到了你想做的事情时，你就进入了开发阶段。

phase.en: This book was published in June 2016, and, as you may remember, this was just as a rather unusual presidential election was reaching its most intense phase.
phase.zh: 这本书出版于2016年6月，正如你可能记得的那样，当时正值一场相当不寻常的总统大选进入最白热化的阶段。

philosophy.en: But it is at least philosophy that is informed by technology and by science.
philosophy.zh: 但它至少是受技术和科学启发的哲学。

philosophy.en: He graduated in 2009 with the highest honours, with a degree in political science and philosophy.
philosophy.zh: 他在2009年以最高荣誉毕业，获得了政治学和哲学学位。

philosophy.en: So if you can teach children this philosophy at an early age, you shortcut all the debates.
philosophy.zh: 所以如果你能从小教给孩子这种哲学，就能省去所有的争论。

philosophy.en: Later, these concepts evolved into modern Chinese philosophy and beliefs.
philosophy.zh: 后来，这些概念演变成了现代的中国哲学和信仰。

philosophy.en: Ulbricht’s idea of a website that allowed users complete anonymity fitted right in with this political philosophy.
philosophy.zh: Ulbricht 想要建立一个允许用户完全匿名的网站，这一想法正好契合了这种政治哲学。

photograph.en: He was photographed riding horses shirtless, diving into icy waters, and piloting fighter jets.
photograph.zh: 镜头记录下他赤膊骑马、冬泳以及驾驶战斗机的画面。

photograph.en: There, they were fingerprinted, photographed, and charged with offences like armed robbery.
photograph.zh: 在那里，他们被采集指纹、拍照，并被指控犯下持械抢劫之类的罪名。

photograph.en: I've seen photographs of the moment. He's looking me in the eye and giving me a firm handshake.
photograph.zh: 我见过那一刻的照片。他直视着我的眼睛，用力地和我握手。

photograph.en: It was only after they consulted photographs of the other high-profile disappearance that year that they made the connection.
photograph.zh: 直到他们查阅了当年另一起备受关注的失踪案的照片后，才把两者联系起来。

photograph.en: He has bowed where he was told to bow, photographed what he was allowed to photograph, and said nothing that might cause offence.
photograph.zh: 该鞠躬的地方他都鞠了躬，只拍了被允许拍的照片，也没说任何可能冒犯到谁的话。

physiological.en: And finally is your emotional and physiological state.
physiological.zh: 最后是你的情绪和生理状态。

physiological.en: Scientists have also looked at physiological measures: heart rate variability, levels of the stress hormone cortisol, and even patterns of brain activity.
physiological.zh: 科学家们还研究了生理指标：心率变异性、压力荷尔蒙皮质醇的水平，甚至是脑电波活动的模式。

physiological.en: When we feel happy, there are clear physiological changes and measuring these kinds of changes is the most accurate way to measure happiness, theoretically speaking, at least.
physiological.zh: 当我们感到快乐时，会有明显的生理变化，从理论上讲，测量这些变化是衡量幸福最准确的方法。

physicist.en: In Paris Marie met Pierre Curie, a physicist who shared her deep interest in experimental science.
physicist.zh: 在巴黎，玛丽遇到了 Pierre Curie，一位与她同样对实验科学有着浓厚兴趣的物理学家。

physicist.en: For young physicists? Yeah, that's my non-profit-y thing.
physicist.zh: 为年轻的物理学家？是的，这就是我做非营利的事情。

physicist.en: I actually think Elon had this one figured out, which is he plowed his own money back into his own businesses to go and do bigger and better things for humanity. um so what i would like to you know you could give it to non-profits but a lot of non-profits are grifty or it's people who didn't earn it trying to spend it or they don't have tight feedback loops on having a good effect so One of the things I want to do as an aside is I want to create a little school for young physicists, but that's my non-profit.
physicist.zh: 我实际上认为Elon想通了这一点，那就是他把自己的钱重新投入到自己的企业中，去为人类做更大更好的事情。所以我想说的是，你可以把它捐给非营利组织，但很多非营利组织是骗人的，或者是那些没赚过钱的人试图去花钱，或者他们在产生良好效果方面没有紧密的反馈循环。所以，顺便说一句，我想做的一件事是为年轻的物理学家建立一所小学校，这就是我的非营利事业。

philanthropy.en: I don't like to talk about it. I don't talk about whatever so-called philanthropy because I think that makes it less real.
philanthropy.zh: 我不喜欢谈论它。我不谈论任何所谓的慈善事业，因为我认为这让它变得不那么真实。

philanthropic.en: That makes it more status-oriented. It makes it less philanthropic.
philanthropic.zh: 这让它变得更以地位为导向。这让它变得不那么慈善了。
